message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clocks or real‑time data feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York right now. If you need the current local time, you could:

1. **Check your phone or computer** – most devices display the time for multiple time zones if you add “New York” as a secondary clock.
2. **Use a web service** – sites like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york) or APIs such as the World Time API (`http://worldtimeapi.org/api/timezone/America/New_York`) will return the current UTC offset, local time, and other details in JSON format.

If you’d like, I can show you how to call the World Time API from Python or JavaScript to retrieve the current time programmatically.
